scope: One bounded privative relation over every declared laukika nominal word-meaning in the first nominal inventory.
reader_label: A noun or descriptive meaning generates its negative counterpart
semantic_relation: the absence, non-occurrence, or negation of the source nominal meaning
counting_rule: One new word-meaning per eligible source word-meaning. Alternative input and output forms remain attached to that meaning.
allomorph_rule: अ- before a consonant and अन्- before a vowel are two surface outcomes of one operation, not separate multipliers.
attestation_rule: Attestation is not an admission requirement. The construction must be grammatically licensed and mechanically formable.
exclusions: vaidika nominal meanings outside the declared laukika inventory
recursive application of नञ् to its own outputs
